A **polyhedron** is the set of solutions of finitely many linear inequalities,
$P = \{x : Ax \le b\}$. It is the feasible region of every linear program and the LP
relaxation of every integer program. These pages cover its two descriptions (inequalities
vs. vertices and rays) and the theorem of the alternative that LP duality rests on.

Prerequisite: [Convexity](../convexity/index.qmd), especially
[Separating Hyperplanes](../convexity/separating-hyperplanes.qmd).
